guides.title: Register an asset
guides.blurb: Add an asset with its tag, details, service schedule and who has it.

steps.title: Asset Registry
steps.text: Click Asset Registry.

steps.title: Register Asset
steps.text: Click Register Asset.

steps.title: Tag and category
steps.text: The number on its tag, and its category.

steps.title: What it is
steps.text: Name, model and serial number.

steps.title: Service schedule
steps.text: How often it needs a service, and whether it's measured in kilometres, hours or time.

steps.title: Who or where
steps.text: Assign it to a person, a department or a place.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Registers the asset. Print its label from Print Labels & Tags.

guides.title: Create a stock item
guides.blurb: Add an item to your catalog with its barcodes.

steps.title: Stock Catalog
steps.text: Click Stock Catalog.

steps.title: Create Stock Item
steps.text: Click Create Stock Item.

steps.title: Code and category
steps.text: Your item code and its stock category.

steps.title: Name
steps.text: What it's called on screens and slips.

steps.title: Serialised
steps.text: Tick for items tracked one by one by serial number (such as radios); leave off for quantities (such as cold drinks).

steps.title: Barcodes
steps.text: One or more barcodes, so the till can scan it.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Then receive stock of it with a GRV.

guides.title: Receive stock (GRV)
guides.blurb: Book stock that arrived into a warehouse.

steps.title: Live Inventory & GRV
steps.text: Click Live Inventory & GRV.

steps.title: Receive GRV
steps.text: Click Receive GRV.

steps.title: Order and warehouse
steps.text: The order or delivery number, and the warehouse it goes into.

steps.title: Items
steps.text: Choose each item and its quantity, or scan each serial number, and add it to the list.

steps.title: Complete
steps.text: Books the stock in. Save Draft if you're not finished; missing items show as shortages.

guides.title: Set up the POS
guides.blurb: Get the till ready: rules, items and prices, cashiers, layout.

steps.title: POS Settings
steps.text: Click POS Settings.

steps.title: 1. Setup
steps.text: Employee account sales and limits, cash, returns and face payment.

steps.title: 2. Items & Prices
steps.text: Which stock items are sold, and their prices.

steps.title: 3. Users & Rights
steps.text: Your cashiers and what each may do.

steps.title: 4. Layout
steps.text: Arrange the till's buttons into categories.

steps.title: 5. Open the till
steps.text: Open the POS screen and start the day.
